source.section: Schedule 3 line 1 (PDF page 24: joint 2,000, all other filers 1,000); Form IT-40 lines 1-8 (PDF page 1; line 8 'multiply line 7 by 3% (.03)'); booklet PDF page 8 Line 1; PDF pages 5-6 rounding

worked: Federal AGI = wages person 0 85,000.00 + wages person 1 40,000.00 + interest 750.00 = 125,750.00. Federal taxable income = 125,750.00 - standard deduction 31,500.00 = 94,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored; Indiana starts from federal AGI). Form IT-40 line 1 federal AGI 125,750.00. Line 2 add-backs 0.00; line 3 = 125,750.00 + 0.00 = 125,750.00. Schedule 2: no deductions; line 12 total = 0.00. IT-40 line 4 = 0.00. Line 5 = 125,750.00 - 0.00 = 125,750.00. Schedule 3: line 1 2,000.00; line 4 0 x 1,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 nobody 65 or older: 0.00; line 7 total = 2,000.00. IT-40 line 6 = 2,000.00. Line 7 = 125,750.00 - 2,000.00 = 123,750.00. Line 8 = 123,750.00 x 0.03 = 3,712.50; the form rounds to the whole dollar and gives 3,713. No credits; county tax (line 9) is local and out of scope. State income tax 3,712.50.
